kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Even birds get jet lagged, study shows
wire.summary: A species of seabirds appears to become disoriented on flights back to its nest due to shifting time zones.

wire.title: Fishing is a key issue in Alaska's tight U.S. Senate race
wire.summary: Alaska's U.S. Senate race is embroiled in an emotional fight over fish. Many in the state rely upon salmon to feed their families but those fish and others are increasingly hard to find.

wire.title: US and Japan agree to establish a Japanese facility for joint missile production
wire.summary: The announcement Wednesday is the latest action by the allies, who have repeatedly expressed alarm over China's growing assertiveness in Asia.

wire.title: China elevates a military general to the Politburo and seeks to strengthen party discipline
wire.summary: This move comes about a year before President Xi Jinping is expected to secure his fourth five-year term.

wire.title: Who benefits when massive AI data centers come to town?
wire.summary: The battle over data centers is hitting the ballot box. Brookings scholar Darrell West talks about how the backlash against the AI boom, flock cameras and tech companies is crossing party lines.

wire.title: Greetings from Baghdad, where Agatha Christie's old home presents its own mystery
wire.summary: The English writer visited Iraq multiple times in the first half of the 20th century and set some of her mystery novels there. The house in Baghdad where she once lived now sits abandoned and crumbling.

wire.title: A stress-free guide to organizing important paperwork and documents
wire.summary: Got piles of mail stacking up in the kitchen? Not sure where your Social Security card is? It might be time to sort through your paperwork. Don't let it overwhelm you with this simple guide.

wire.title: With days to go before the midterms, data shows the U.S. economy is doing well
wire.summary: GDP grew at an annual rate of 3.4% in the third quarter in the last major read on the economy ahead of the midterm elections — but many Americans continue to struggle with affordability.

wire.title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
wire.summary: Economists expect the GDP report to show economic growth, but say that growth is "fragile." And, after 90% of the votes in Israel have been counted, no clear winner has emerged.

wire.title: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
wire.summary: Artificial intelligence is making drones faster and more capable. Russia and Ukraine both use AI-powered drones, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that AI could lead decisions on the battlefield as soon as next year.

wire.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
wire.summary: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.

wire.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
wire.summary: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

wire.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
wire.summary: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

wire.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
wire.summary: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

wire.title: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports
wire.summary: One of the region's famous rock formations, known as "fairy chimneys", reportedly collapsed outside an open-air museum.

wire.title: EU chief lays out vision for new Canada partnership at Montreal summit
wire.summary: Ursula von der Leyen continued to use the term "associate member" for Canada despite some opposition of the bloc's members, including Germany.
